verses.original: Πολυμερῶς καὶ πολυτρόπως πάλαι ὁ Θεὸς λαλήσας τοῖς πατράσιν ἐν τοῖς προφήταις
verses.transliteration: Polymerōs kai polytropōs palai ho Theos lalēsas tois patrasin en tois prophētais
verses.literal: On many past occasions and in many different ways God spoke to our fathers through the prophets

verses.original: ἐπ’ ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν τούτων ἐλάλησεν ἡμῖν ἐν Υἱῷ ὃν ἔθηκεν κληρονόμον πάντων δι’ οὗ καὶ ἐποίησεν τοὺς αἰῶνας
verses.transliteration: ep’ eschatou tōn hēmerōn toutōn elalēsen hēmin en Huiō hon ethēken klēronomon pantōn di’ hou kai epoiēsen tous aiōnas
verses.literal: But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son whom He appointed heir of all things and through whom He made the universe

verses.original: ὃς ὢν ἀπαύγασμα τῆς δόξης καὶ χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως αὐτοῦ φέρων τε τὰ πάντα τῷ ῥήματι τῆς δυνάμεως δι’ αὐτοῦ καθαρισμὸν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ποιησάμενος ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τῆς Μεγαλωσύνης ἐν ὑψηλοῖς
verses.transliteration: hos ōn apaugasma tēs doxēs kai charaktēr tēs hypostaseōs autou pherōn te ta panta tō rhēmati tēs dynameōs di’ autou katharismon tōn hamartiōn poiēsamenos ekathisen en dexia tēs Megalōsynēs en hypsēlois
verses.literal: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature upholding all things by His powerful word After He had provided purification for sins He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high

verses.original: τοσούτῳ κρείττων γενόμενος τῶν ἀγγέλων ὅσῳ διαφορώτερον παρ’ αὐτοὺς κεκληρονόμηκεν ὄνομα
verses.transliteration: tosoutō kreittōn genomenos tōn angelōn hosō diaphorōteron par’ autous keklēronomēken onoma
verses.literal: So He became as far superior to the angels as the name He has inherited is excellent beyond theirs

verses.original: Τίνι γὰρ εἶπέν ποτε τῶν ἀγγέλων Υἱός μου εἶ σύ ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε Καὶ πάλιν Ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς Πατέρα καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι εἰς Υἱόν
verses.transliteration: Tini gar eipen pote tōn angelōn Huios mou ei sy egō sēmeron gegennēka se Kai palin Egō esomai autō eis Patera kai autos estai moi eis Huion
verses.literal: For to which of the angels did God ever say You are My Son today I have become Your Father . . . Or again I will be His Father and He will be My Son

verses.original: Ὅταν δὲ πάλιν εἰσαγάγῃ τὸν πρωτότοκον εἰς τὴν οἰκουμένην λέγει Καὶ προσκυνησάτωσαν αὐτῷ πάντες ἄγγελοι Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hotan de palin eisagagē ton prōtotokon eis tēn oikoumenēn legei Kai proskynēsatōsan autō pantes angeloi Theou
verses.literal: And again when God brings His firstborn into the world He says Let all God’s angels worship Him

verses.original: Καὶ πρὸς μὲν τοὺς ἀγγέλους λέγει Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα καὶ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ πυρὸς φλόγα
verses.transliteration: Kai pros men tous angelous legei Ho poiōn tous angelous autou pneumata kai tous leitourgous autou pyros phloga
verses.literal: Now . . . about the angels He says He makes His angels winds His servants flames of fire

verses.original: Πρὸς δὲ τὸν Υἱόν Ὁ θρόνος σου ὁ Θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς εὐθύτητος ῥάβδος τῆς βασιλείας σου
verses.transliteration: Pros de ton Huion Ho thronos sou ho Theos eis ton aiōna tou aiōnos kai hē rhabdos tēs euthytētos rhabdos tēs basileias sou
verses.literal: But about the Son He says Your throne O God endures forever . . . . . . and ever and - justice is the scepter of Your kingdom

verses.original: ἠγάπησας δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἐμίσησας ἀνομίαν διὰ τοῦτο ἔχρισέν σε ὁ Θεός ὁ Θεός σου ἔλαιον ἀγαλλιάσεως παρὰ τοὺς μετόχους σου
verses.transliteration: ēgapēsas dikaiosynēn kai emisēsas anomian dia touto echrisen se ho Theos ho Theos sou elaion agalliaseōs para tous metochous sou
verses.literal: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness therefore . . . God Your God has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy

verses.original: Καί Σὺ κατ’ ἀρχάς Κύριε τὴν γῆν ἐθεμελίωσας καὶ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σού εἰσιν οἱ οὐρανοί
verses.transliteration: Kai Sy kat’ archas Kyrie tēn gēn ethemeliōsas kai erga tōn cheirōn sou eisin hoi ouranoi
verses.literal: And In the beginning O Lord You laid the foundations of the earth and the heavens are the work of Your hands

verses.original: αὐτοὶ ἀπολοῦνται σὺ δὲ διαμένεις καὶ πάντες ὡς ἱμάτιον παλαιωθήσονται
verses.transliteration: autoi apolountai sy de diameneis kai pantes hōs himation palaiōthēsontai
verses.literal: They will perish but You remain they will all wear out like a garment

verses.original: καὶ ὡσεὶ περιβόλαιον ἑλίξεις αὐτούς ὡς ἱμάτιον καὶ ἀλλαγήσονται σὺ δὲ ὁ αὐτὸς εἶ καὶ τὰ ἔτη σου οὐκ ἐκλείψουσιν
verses.transliteration: kai hōsei peribolaion helixeis autous hōs himation kai allagēsontai sy de ho autos ei kai ta etē sou ouk ekleipsousin
verses.literal: You will roll them up . . . like a robe like a garment they will be changed but You remain the same and Your years will never end

verses.original: Πρὸς τίνα δὲ τῶν ἀγγέλων εἴρηκέν ποτε Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου
verses.transliteration: Pros tina de tōn angelōn eirēken pote Kathou ek dexiōn mou heōs an thō tous echthrous sou hypopodion tōn podōn sou
verses.literal: Yet to which of the angels did God ever say Sit at My right hand until . . . I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet

verses.original: Οὐχὶ πάντες εἰσὶν λειτουργικὰ πνεύματα εἰς διακονίαν ἀποστελλόμενα διὰ τοὺς μέλλοντας κληρονομεῖν σωτηρίαν
verses.transliteration: Ouchi pantes eisin leitourgika pneumata eis diakonian apostellomena dia tous mellontas klēronomein sōtērian
verses.literal: Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve . . . those who will inherit salvation
